paragraphs: Clear Secure, Inc. (the "Company" or "CLEAR") is a secure identity company making experiences safer and easier - both digitally and physically. We make everyday experiences frictionless by connecting your identity to all the things that make you, YOU - transforming the way you live, work, and travel. CLEAR has been delivering secure, frictionless experiences in airports for over 15 years, achieving exceptional user delight and trust with CLEAR+, our consumer travel subscription service. CLEAR+ enables access to predictable and fast experiences through dedicated entry lanes in airport security checkpoints nationwide. Additionally, our CLEAR Travel portfolio includes TSA PreCheck® Enrollment Provided by CLEAR, premium services such as CLEAR Concierge, other travel benefits such as expedited passport services, our free CLEAR app which helps travelers plan their trip Home to Gate, and other mobile-first identity solutions such as CLEAR ID. Our CLEAR Travel portfolio extends CLEAR's value proposition beyond the airport lane and supports our strategy to expand use cases, increase engagement and address new customer segments such as international travelers. CLEAR1 is our business to business ("B2B") multi-layered identity verification solution. We combine biometric, document and device signals with verified data sources to ensure users are who they claim to be. Our B2B partners can select which verification layers to deploy, based on their specific security requirements, risk tolerance and user experience goals. We partner with a breadth of organizations, with a particular focus on Healthcare, Workforce and Governmental organizations where high fidelity identity security is paramount to their operational success. Our scaled Member base and comprehensive secure identity platform underpin our CLEAR Travel and CLEAR1 businesses, maximizing security and minimizing friction for consumers and our enterprise partners.

Since 2010 we have been expanding our network, investing in our technology platform, strengthening our operations and developing our team members to consistently deliver increased value to Members and partners, resulting in the growth and trust of CLEAR.

We have built an extensive physical footprint with a nationwide network of airports and partners to offer Members frictionless, trusted experiences as they move and transact throughout the day in both physical and digital environments. As of December 31, 2025, our expansive network of partners and use cases provide our 38 million Total CLEAR Members with access to 166 CLEAR+ Lanes across 60 airports nationwide, 61 airports and 340 retail locations with TSA PreCheck® Enrollment Provided by CLEAR, 9 sports and entertainment venues with priority Lanes and a growing list of B2B CLEAR1 partners. The continued expansion of our capabilities enable our partners to integrate CLEAR1 solutions and give our Members new places and new ways to use CLEAR.

At CLEAR, we are obsessed with the Member experience. Our physical and digital network, technology platform, operational expertise and 3,708 Ambassadors and field managers across our airport partners have helped us build a trusted brand and a passionate Member base. Our Members know to expect a frictionless, predictable, and secure experience when they see the CLEAR brand. Similarly, our partners trust CLEAR to enable them to deliver the same frictionless and secure experiences to their own customers.

Our business model is powered by network effects and characterized by efficient Member acquisition and maintaining strong retention rates. Our largest CLEAR+ Member acquisition channel is in-airport (representing 66%, 64%, and 65% of Member acquisitions for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively), where our prominent branding and expansive physical footprint allow prospective Members to engage with CLEAR's brand, Ambassadors and technology firsthand. Our passionate Member base further drives word-of-mouth marketing and strong retention rates. As we add partners, products and locations, our platform becomes more valuable to our Members. In turn, as we grow membership, our platform is more valuable to our existing and prospective partners. In addition, we have grown Total CLEAR Members 31% year over year to 38.0 million, further increasing the scale and value of our secure identity platform to current and prospective CLEAR1 partners.
Our platform is multi-faceted and a powerful network of networks. Our Member base includes CLEAR+ Members and CLEAR Platform Members.

CLEAR+ Members pay for our annual CLEAR+ consumer travel subscription service. We started in airports and witnessed accelerating Member growth in both new markets and existing markets as our network expanded. The ability to

use CLEAR in more locations and in more ways increases our utility to our Members. In 2025, we expanded CLEAR+ and related offerings to serve international travelers from 42 countries, broadening the addressable market for our platform and increasing the relevance of CLEAR+ for a global traveler base.

CLEAR Platform Members include Members who enrolled through our mobile app, our partners' customers who have enrolled through our CLEAR1 solutions, and formerly paying CLEAR+ Members. Platform Members can use CLEAR anywhere in our network outside of CLEAR+ service for free, while our CLEAR1 partners pay to use our technology solutions. Typically, new platform Members are driven to enroll by one of our CLEAR1 partners who integrate with CLEAR to enable frictionless experiences for their customers. Platform Members also may enroll directly with CLEAR to access our expanding portfolio of use cases.

We believe there is a significant opportunity to expand our reach. We expect to expand CLEAR+ through airport network expansion, increased market penetration in existing markets, partnerships, new products and services, and our digital marketing efforts. We also expect to continue adding new airport and retail locations offering TSA PreCheck® provided by CLEAR. Additionally, we have a robust pipeline of new CLEAR1 partners who increasingly recognize the need to deliver a seamless and secure experience to their customers.

As CLEAR has evolved into a multi-product secure identity platform serving both consumer and enterprise use cases, management uses certain key performance indicators to evaluate the scale, engagement, and monetization of the CLEAR network across CLEAR+, CLEAR1, and other emerging identity use cases.

Total CLEAR Members is used to measure the overall reach of the CLEAR platform and the growth of our enrolled Member base across both paid and unpaid channels. This metric reflects enrollment driven by CLEAR+, CLEAR1 partner integrations, digital identity adoption, and international traveler use cases, and provides insight into the expanding utility and extensibility of the CLEAR network.

Active CLEAR+ Members is used to assess the monetization of our consumer aviation subscription offering and the demand for predictable, frictionless travel experiences. This metric helps management evaluate the portion of the Member base that contributes revenue.

Definitions of these metrics and additional discussion of period-to-period changes are included in Item 7 — Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations, "Key Performance Indicators".

headings: Risks Related to Our Business, Brand and Operations
If we fail to add new or retain existing partners, or profit from partner relationships, our business, results of operations and financial condition could be materially and adversely affected.
If we are not able to meet stakeholder expectations or to maintain the value and reputation of our brand, our business and financial results may be harmed.
We operate in a highly competitive market, and we may be unable to compete successfully against existing and future competitors.
Public confidence in, and acceptance of, identity platforms and biometrics generally, and our platform specifically, will be a key factor in our business's continued growth.
Our metrics and estimates are subject to inherent challenges in measurement, and real or perceived inaccuracies in those metrics may harm our reputation and negatively affect our business.
We might not implement successful strategies to increase the adoption of our platform or expand into new verticals, which would limit our growth.
Our commercial agreements and strategic alliances, as well as potential indemnification obligations, expose us to risk.
Portions of our business and results of operations depend upon concessionaire agreements.
Any decline or disruption in the travel industry or general economic downturn could materially adversely affect our business, results of operations and financial condition.
We may require additional capital to support business growth and objectives, and this capital might not be available to us on reasonable terms, if at all, and may result in stockholder dilution.

Our business depends on retaining and attracting high-quality personnel, including certain key personnel, and continued or future attrition, or unsuccessful succession planning could adversely affect our business.
Our business could be adversely impacted by changes in the Internet browsers and mobile device accessibility of Members.
We are subject to payment processing risk.
Our business may be vulnerable to the adverse effects of climate change, which may negatively impact our operations.
We have limited experience operating outside the United States and any future international expansion strategy will subject us to additional costs and risks and our plans may not be successful.
Risks Related to Information Technology and Intellectual Property

There may be breaches of our information technology systems that subject us to significant reputational, financial, legal and operational consequences or materially damage Member and partner relationships.

•failure to add new and retain existing Members, including Active CLEAR+ Members, or increase the utilization of our platform, and the failure to add new or retain existing partners;

Additionally, our CLEAR Travel portfolio includes TSA PreCheck® Enrollment Provided by CLEAR, premium services such as CLEAR Concierge, other travel benefits such as expedited passport services, our free CLEAR app which helps travelers plan their trip Home to Gate, and other mobile-first identity solutions such as CLEAR ID. Our CLEAR Travel portfolio extends CLEAR's value proposition beyond the airport lane and supports our strategy to expand use cases, increase engagement and address new customer segments such as international travelers. We believe that our current and future financial growth are dependent upon many factors, including the key factors affecting performance described below.

We are focused on growing Total CLEAR Members and the number of Members that engage with our platform. Our operating results and growth opportunities depend, in part, on our ability to attract new Members, including paying Members (CLEAR+ Members) as well as new platform Members. We rely on multiple channels to attract new CLEAR+ Members, including in-airport (our largest channel) which in turn is dependent on the ongoing ability of our Ambassadors to successfully engage with the traveling public. We also rely on numerous digital channels such as our website, mobile app and paid search. We also entered into strategic distribution partnerships with partners such as Delta Air Lines, United Airlines, Alaska Airlines, Hawaiian Airlines and American Express that promote our services to their customers on a discounted or subsidized basis which helps us to efficiently scale membership in CLEAR+. Through our partnership with American Express, eligible card members receive statement credits for all or a portion of their CLEAR Plus membership. We initially entered into our partnership with American Express in 2019. In February 2026, we executed a multi-year renewal of the partnership with American Express. In many cases, we offer limited time trials to new Members who may convert to paying Members upon the completion of their trial. Our future success is dependent on those channels continuing to drive new Members and our ability to convert trial Members into paying Members.

Our ability to execute on our growth strategy is focused, in part, on our ability to retain our existing CLEAR+ Members. Frequency and recency of usage are the leading indicators of retention, and we must continue to provide frictionless and predictable experiences that our Members will use in their daily lives. We are subject to various factors which may be out of our control and may impact our Member experience, such as checkpoint staffing generally, checkpoint queue configurations and Registered Traveler policies adopted by TSA. For example, the TSA employs varied randomization as part of their normal security processes. If the TSA materially increases randomized reverification rates for CLEAR+ Members at the checkpoint or makes other adjustments to checkpoint processes, it may negatively impact the Lane experience and therefore may impact our ability to retain CLEAR+ Members.

The value of the CLEAR platform to our Members increases as we add more use cases and partnerships, which in turn drives more frequent usage and strong retention. We cannot be sure that we will be successful in retaining our Members due to any number of factors such as our inability to successfully implement a new product, adoption of our technology, harm to our brand or other factors. If our efforts to develop and offer more benefits are not valued by our current and future CLEAR+ Members, our ability to attract and retain CLEAR+ Members, or increase pricing, may be negatively impacted.

Our partners include local airport authorities, airlines and other businesses. Our future success depends on maintaining those relationships, adding new relationships and maintaining favorable business terms. In addition, our growth strategy relies on creating new revenue streams such as per partner, per Member or per use transaction fees. Although we believe our service provides significant value to our partners, our success depends on creating mutually beneficial partnership agreements. We are focused on innovating both our product and our platform to improve our Members' experience, improve safety and security and introduce new use cases. We intend to accelerate our pace of innovation to add more features and use cases, to ultimately deliver greater value to our Members and partners. In the near term, we believe that growing our Member base facilitates our ability to add new partnerships and provide additional offerings, which we expect will lead to revenue generation opportunities in the long term.

Our financial performance is dependent in part on new partner, product and location launches. In many cases, we cannot predict the exact timing of those launches. Delays, resulting either from internal or external factors, may have a material effect on our financial results.
Although many of our expenses occur in a predictable fashion, certain expenses may fluctuate from period to period due to timing.

In addition, management may make discretionary investments when it sees an opportunity to accelerate growth, add a new partner or acquire talent, among other reasons. This may lead to volatility or unpredictability in our expense base and in our profitability.

paragraphs: Clear Secure, Inc. (the "Company" or "CLEAR") 為一間提供安全身分辨識的公司，使數位與實體體驗更加安全且便捷。我們透過將您的身分與所有讓您成為您自己的事物連結，使日常體驗更加順暢，改變您生活、工作與旅行的方式。CLEAR 自 15 年前開始在機場提供安全且順暢的體驗，並透過我們的消費者旅行訂閱服務 CLEAR+，為用戶帶來極佳的滿意度與信任。CLEAR+ 透過全國機場安全檢查點的專用通道，提供可預測且快速的體驗。此外，我們的 CLEAR Travel 產品組合包含 TSA PreCheck® Enrollment Provided by CLEAR、高階服務如 CLEAR Concierge、其他旅行福利如加急護照服務、我們的免費 CLEAR 應用程式，協助旅客規劃從家到機場的行程，以及其他以行動為首的身分解決方案如 CLEAR ID。我們的 CLEAR Travel 產品組合將 CLEAR 的價值主張延伸至機場通道之外，支持我們擴展使用情境、提高參與度並面對新客羣如國際旅客。CLEAR1 是我們的企業對企業 ("B2B") 多層次身分驗證解決方案。我們結合生物特徵、文件與裝置訊號與驗證資料來源，確保用戶為其聲稱的身分。我們的 B2、B 合作夥伴可根據其特定的安全需求、風險承受度與用戶體驗目標，選擇部署哪些驗證層級。我們與廣泛的組織合作，特別聚焦於醫療、人力資源與政府機構，這些機構的高忠實度身分安全對其運營成功至關重要。我們的擴展會員基礎與全面的安全身分平台支撐我們的 CLEAR Travel 與 CLEAR1 事業，為消費者與企業合作夥伴提供更高的安全性與更低的摩擦。
自 2010 年以來，我們持續擴展網路、投資於技術平台、強化運營並培訓團隊成員，以持續為會員與合作夥伴提供更高的價值，進而實現 CLEAR 的成長與信任。

我們已建立廣泛的實體網路，透過全國機場與合作夥伴的網路，為會員在實體與數位環境中移動與交易時提供順暢且可信任的體驗。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們廣泛的合作夥伴網路與使用情境，為我們的 3800 萬總 CLEAR 會員提供 60 個機場的 166 個 CLEAR+ 通道、61 個機場與 340 個零售點的 TSA PreCheck® Enrollment Provided by CLEAR、9 個體育與娛樂場地的優先通道，以及持續增長的 B2B CLEAR1 合作夥伴。我們持續擴展能力的同時，使合作夥伴能整合 CLEAR1 解決方案，並為會員提供新的使用場景與方式。
在 CLEAR，我們對會員體驗著迷。我們的實體與數位網路、技術平台、運營專業知識與在機場合作夥伴中的 3,708 名大使與現場經理，協助我們建立一個受信任的品牌與熱情的會員羣。我們的會員知道，當他們看到 CLEAR 品牌時，可以期待順暢、可預測且安全的體驗。同樣地，我們的合作夥伴信任 CLEAR 能協助他們為自己的客戶提供相同的順暢與安全體驗。

本公司商業模式依賴網路效應，並以高效能的會員取得及維持強勁的留存率為特徵。本公司最大的CLEAR+會員取得通路為機場內（分別佔2025年、2024年及2023年會員取得數的66%、64%及65%），在該通路中，本公司顯著的品牌形象及廣泛的實體據點使潛在會員能親身體驗CLEAR的品牌、大使及技術。熱情的會員羣體進一步推動口碑行銷及強勁的留存率。隨著我們增加合作夥伴、產品及據點，我們的平台對會員而言價值更高。換言之，隨著我們會員數成長，我們的平台對現有及潛在合作夥伴而言價值更高。此外，我們的總CLEAR會員數年增31%至3800萬，進一步提高我們安全身分平台的規模與價值，以服務現有及潛在CLEAR1合作夥伴。
我們的平台多樣化，並為一個強大且互聯的網路。我們的會員羣體包括CLEAR+會員及CLEAR平台會員。
CLEAR+會員支付我們年度CLEAR+消費者旅行訂閱服務費用。我們從機場起步，並隨著網路擴張，在新市場及現有市場中觀察到會員成長加速。能夠
在更多地點及更多方式使用CLEAR，使我們的平台對會員而言更具實用性。2025年，我們擴展CLEAR+及相關服務，以服務來自42個國家的國際旅客，擴大我們平台的可接觸市場，並提高CLEAR+對全球旅客羣體的相關性。

CLEAR 平台成員包括透過我們行動應用程式註冊的成員、透過我們 CLEAR1 解決方案註冊的合作夥伴客戶，以及 formerly paying CLEAR+ 成員。平台成員可在我們的網路中任何非 CLEAR+ 服務的地區免費使用 CLEAR，而我們的 CLEAR1 合作夥伴則需支付費用以使用我們的技術解決方案。通常，新平台成員是因我們 CLEAR1 合作夥伴整合 CLEAR 以提供無摩擦體驗給其客戶而註冊。平台成員也可直接透過 CLEAR 註冊以使用我們不斷擴充的應用案例組合。
我們認為有著擴大我們影響力的重大機會。我們預期透過機場網路擴張、現有市場的市場滲透率提升、合作夥伴關係、新產品與服務以及我們的數位行銷努力來擴展 CLEAR+。我們也預期持續新增提供 TSA PreCheck® 的機場與零售據點。此外，我們擁有強大的新 CLEAR1 合作夥伴管道，這些合作夥伴越來越認同提供無縫且安全的體驗給其客戶的必要性。
隨著 CLEAR 發展成為一個多產品的安全身分平台，服務消費者與企業的應用案例，管理階層使用某些關鍵績效指標來評估 CLEAR 網路在 CLEAR+、CLEAR1 以及其他新興身分應用案例中的規模、參與度與商業化程度。
總 CLEAR 成員數用來衡量 CLEAR 平台的整體影響力以及我們註冊成員基礎在付費與非付費管道的成長。此指標反映因 CLEAR+、CLEAR1 合作夥伴整合、數位身分採用以及國際旅客應用案例而產生的註冊，並提供有關 CLEAR 網路擴展功能與延展性的洞察。
活躍 CLEAR+ 成員數用來評估我們消費者航空訂閱服務的商業化程度以及對可預測、無摩擦旅行體驗的需求。此指標幫助管理階層評估成員基礎中產生收入的部分。
這些指標的定義以及對期別變動的進一步討論，包含於第 7 項 — 管理層對財務狀況與營運成果的討論與分析，"關鍵績效指標" 部分。

paragraphs: 下列為管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之分析（"MD&A"），旨在協助讀者瞭解本公司營運成果、財務狀況與現金流，應與本年度10-K申報表所附之審計過之合併財務報表及相關附註一併閱讀。本討論包含風險與不確定性之預測性陳述。本公司實際結果可能與以下所述有重大差異。
為此MD&A之目的，"we"及其它形式之用語指Clear Secure, Inc.及其子公司（合稱"本公司"），包含Alclear Holdings, LLC（"Alclear"）。

本年度10-K申報表包含若干預測性陳述，依聯邦證券法之定義，涉及本公司或管理層之意圖、計畫、信念、期望或對未來事件之預測，此類陳述視為預測性陳述。您不應過度依賴這些陳述，因其受許多不確定因素與變數影響，與本公司營運與商業環境相關，且許多因素難以預測，且多數超出本公司控制範圍。預測性陳述包含有關本公司可能或假設之未來營運結果之資訊，包含對本公司業務策略之描述。這些陳述常包含"may"、"will"、"should"、"believe"、"expect"、"anticipate"、"intend"、"plan"、"estimate"等詞彙。這些陳述基於本公司根據產業經驗、歷史趨勢、當前狀況、預期未來發展及其他因素所做出之假設。當您閱讀本年度10-K申報表時，應瞭解這些陳述並非績效或結果之保證。它們涉及已知與未知之風險、不確定性與假設，包含於本年度10-K申報表"Part I – Item 1A. Risk Factors"標題下所描述之風險因素。雖然本公司認為這些預測性陳述基於合理假設，但您應知悉許多因素，包含於本年度10-K申報表"Risk Factors"標題下所描述之因素，可能影響本公司實際財務結果或營運結果，並可能導致實際結果與預測性陳述中所述有重大差異。
本公司 herein 所做之預測性陳述僅於本年度10-K申報表之日期為準。本公司明確聲明不具任何更新或修正 herein 所做預測性陳述之意圖、義務或承諾，以反映任何對該預測性陳述之期望變更，或任何影響該預測性陳述之事件、條件或情況之變更。所有後續之書面與口頭預測性陳述，歸屬本公司或代表本公司行事之人，均完全受本年度10-K申報表所含之警示性陳述所限制。

本MD&A之討論一般與2025及2024項目及2025與2024年之年對年比較有關。有關2023項目及2024與2023年之年對年比較之討論，未包含於本年度10-K申報表中，可於本公司2024年12月31日財務年度之年度報告（Form 10-K）第二部分，第7項"Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations"中找到。

Clear Secure, Inc.（"本公司"或"CLEAR"）為一提供安全身分認證之公司，使數位與實體體驗更安全且更便捷。我們透過將您的身分與所有使您成為您自己之事物連結，使日常體驗更順暢，改變您生活、工作與旅行的方式。CLEAR自15年前起便在機場提供安全、順暢之體驗，並透過CLEAR+消費者旅行訂閱服務，獲得極佳之用戶滿意度與信任。CLEAR+使用戶能透過全國機場安全檢查通道之專屬通道，獲得預測且快速之體驗。此外，CLEAR Travel產品組合包含TSA PreCheck® Enrollment Provided by CLEAR、高階服務如CLEAR Concierge、其他旅行福利如加快護照服務、免費CLEAR應用程式協助旅客規劃從家到機場之行程，以及其他以行動為首之身分解決方案如CLEAR ID。CLEAR Travel產品組合使CLEAR之價值主張超越機場通道，支持我們擴展使用案例、提高參與度並面對新客戶羣體如國際旅客。CLEAR1為本公司之企業對企業（"B2B"）多層次身分驗證解決方案。我們結合生物特徵、文件與裝置信號與驗證資料來源，確保用戶為其所聲稱之人。我們之B2B合作夥伴可根據其特定安全需求、風險容忍度與用戶體驗目標，選擇部署哪些驗證層。我們與多種組織合作，特別著重於醫療、人力資源與政府機構，因高準確度之身分安全對其運營成功至關重要。我們規模化的會員基礎與全面之安全身分平台支撐CLEAR Travel與CLEAR1業務，為消費者與企業合作夥伴提供最大之安全與最小之摩擦。
我們認為本公司目前與未來之財務成長取決於許多因素，包含下列影響表現之關鍵因素。

我們專注於成長Total CLEAR會員數與與我們平台互動之會員數。我們之營運結果與成長機會部分取決於我們吸引新會員之能力，包含付費會員（CLEAR+會員）與新平台會員。我們依賴多種渠道吸引新CLEAR+會員，包含機場內（我們最大之渠道），而此又依賴我們大使持續成功與旅人互動之能力。我們亦依賴多種數位渠道，如網站、行動應用程式與付費搜尋。我們亦與Delta Air Lines、United Airlines、Alaska Airlines、Hawaiian Airlines與American Express等策略性分銷合作夥伴合作，以折扣或補貼方式向其客戶推廣我們之服務，協助我們高效擴展CLEAR+會員數。透過與American Express之合作，符合資格之信用卡會員可獲得帳單信用額，以抵銷CLEAR Plus會員費用之全部或部分。我們於2019年首次與American Express合作。2026年2月，我們與American Express簽訂多年期合作協議。在許多情況下，我們為新會員提供有限時間試用期，會員可能在試用期結束後轉為付費會員。我們未來之成功取決於這些渠道持續吸引新會員，以及我們將試用會員轉為付費會員之能力。

本公司執行成長策略的能力，部分取決於能否維持現有 CLEAR+ 會員。使用頻率與最近使用時間是留存率的主要指標，我們必須持續提供無摩擦且可預測的體驗，讓會員在日常生活中使用。我們受到多種因素影響，這些因素可能超出我們的控制範圍，並可能影響會員體驗，例如總體經濟因素、檢查站人數配置及 TSA 所採用的註冊旅客政策。例如，TSA 在其正常安全程序中會使用不同形式的隨機化。如果 TSA 對 CLEAR+ 會員在檢查站的隨機重新驗證率大幅提高，或對檢查站程序做出其他調整，可能會對通道體驗產生負面影響，進而影響我們維持 CLEAR+ 會員的能力。
CLEAR 平台對會員的價值，隨著我們增加更多使用案例與合作夥伴而提升，這進而驅動更頻繁的使用與強勁的留存率。我們無法確定是否能成功維持會員，原因可能包括無法成功推出新產品、技術的採用、品牌受損或其他因素。如果我們努力開發並提供更多好處的行動未被現有及未來的 CLEAR+ 會員所認可，則我們吸引與維持 CLEAR+ 會員的能力，或提高價格的潛力，可能會受到負面影響。

我們的合作夥伴包括地方機場當局、航空公司及其他企業。我們未來的成功取決於維持這些關係、增加新關係以及維持有利的商業條款。此外，我們的成長策略依賴於創造新的收入來源，例如按合作夥伴、會員或使用次數收取費用。雖然我們相信我們的服務對合作夥伴具有顯著價值，但我們的成功取決於建立雙方受益的合作協議。我們專注於創新我們的產品與平台，以改善會員體驗、提升安全與保安，並引入新的使用案例。我們有意加快創新速度，增加更多功能與使用案例，最終為會員與合作夥伴提供更大價值。在短期內，我們認為擴大會員基礎有助於我們增加新合作夥伴並提供額外服務，這是我們預期在長遠會帶來收入機會的關鍵。
我們的財務表現部分取決於新合作夥伴、產品與場地的推出。在許多情況下，我們無法預測這些推出的確切時間。延誤，無論是來自內部或外部因素，都可能對我們的財務結果產生重大影響。
雖然許多費用會以可預測的方式產生，但某些費用可能因時間因素而從一個會計期間變動到另一個會計期間。
此外，管理層可能在看到加速成長、增加新合作夥伴或招募人才等機會時，做出酌情投資。這可能會導致我們費用基準與獲利能力的波動或不可預測性。

headings: 與本公司業務、品牌及營運相關的風險
若本公司未能增加新夥伴或留住現有夥伴，或無法從夥伴關係中獲利，將可能對本公司業務、營運結果及財務狀況造成重大且不利的影響。
若本公司無法達到利害關係人期待或維持品牌價值與聲譽，將可能對本公司業務及財務結果造成損害。
本公司營運於高度競爭的市場，可能無法成功對抗現有及未來的競爭對手。
公眾對身分平台及生物特徵技術的信賴與接受度，特別是本公司平台，將是本公司業務持續成長的關鍵因素。
本公司指標與預估數據面臨內在的衡量挑戰，若這些指標出現實際或被認為不準確的情況，將可能損害本公司聲譽並對業務產生負面影響。
本公司可能無法成功實施策略以提高平台採用率或拓展至新產業垂直領域，這將限制本公司成長。
本公司之商業契約與戰略聯盟，以及潛在之賠償義務，使本公司面臨風險。
本公司部分業務與營運成果依賴於特許經營契約。
若旅遊業出現衰退或總體經濟陷入衰退，可能對本公司之業務、營運成果與財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
本公司可能需要額外資金以支應業務成長與目標，而此資金可能無法以合理條件取得，甚至無法取得，並可能導致股東持股稀釋。
本公司業務依賴於保留與吸引高品質人才，包括特定關鍵人才，若持續或未來出現人才流失，或繼任計畫失敗，可能對本公司業務造成不利影響。
本公司業務可能因成員之網路瀏覽器與行動裝置存取性變動而受到不利影響。
本公司面臨支付處理風險。
本公司業務可能受到氣候變遷之不利影響，此可能對本公司營運造成負面影響。
我們在美國境外運營的經驗有限，任何未來的國際擴張策略將使我們面臨額外的成本與風險，且我們的計畫可能無法成功。
與資訊科技及智慧財產權相關的風險
我們的資訊科技系統可能遭入侵，使我們面臨重大聲譽、財務、法律及運營後果，或嚴重損害會員及夥伴關係。
paragraphs: 以下為可能對本公司業務、營運及財務成果產生負面影響的主要風險摘要。如需更完整的風險討論，請參閱下文。
•無法增加新會員及保留現有會員，包括活躍CLEAR+會員，或提高平台使用率，以及無法增加新或保留現有合作夥伴；
•無法達成利害關係人期待或維持品牌價值與聲譽；
•無法成功競爭對現有及未來競爭對手，以及本公司所處高度競爭市場；
•與新技術解決方案及服務採用率增加相關的風險，包括第三方身分驗證解決方案及憑證認證解決方案；
•公眾對身分平台及生物特徵的一般信心與接受度，以及本公司平台具體而言；
